title: Total Valid Transactions
summary: Parse, validate, convert, and aggregate transaction text.

contract.input: A collection of arbitrary transaction text values using name:amount.
contract.output: The numeric total of valid transaction amounts.

examples.input: two valid and two malformed transactions

commonMistakes: accepting empty names or incomplete decimals

blocks.content: Each transaction should contain exactly one colon separating a non-empty trimmed name and valid signed decimal amount text. The decimal format uses an optional sign, digits before an optional decimal point, and digits after a present decimal point. Return the total of valid amounts and ignore malformed transactions.

blocks.title: valid_transaction_total(transactions)
blocks.content:
Input: A collection of arbitrary transaction text values using name:amount.

blocks.caption: Only 12.5 and -2 are valid amounts.

blocks.title: Constraints
blocks.content:
0 <= number of transactions <= 1000
delimiter is exactly colon
no escaping rules
